mentions.name: pact
mentions.description: A tool that enables developers and less technical users to interact with Playwright and perform actions and tests on web-based user interfaces and applications using either a YAML file or a simple DSL (.pact file). It began as a feature for a PR on the venom integration testing tool and was spun out as a standalone tool; it is early stage but already supports basic actions using CSS selectors that Playwright supports.
mentions.audience: Developers and hopefully less technical users
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on pact[0], a tool to enable developers and hopefully less technical users to interact with Playwright and perform actions and tests on web-based user interfaces and applications using either a YAML file or a simple DSL (in a .pact file).
